chapter: Sideman years: J.J., Tyree Glenn, Sweets
title: The exotic dancer job with Jo Jo McKinney
summary: After the Phil Hill episode Elvin briefly played for a dancer and a singer with no pitch.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I just wanted to begin by reviewing some literature in interviews with you. There was an episode we didn’t cover yesterday when you were discussing your work in Pontiac and Detroit. After that piano player ran out with the money, you followed his footsteps in the snow, he ran off with the money there during the holiday season. You had another job immediately after that which you didn’t discuss.

I took a job with this friend of ours his name is Jo Jo McKinney beautiful voice he is a very good singer. He got this job and he said “we need a drummer” cause they had an exotic dancer and I said “I know how to do that.” This lady who was the girlfriend of the guy who owned this club, she was the star the singer. The first night really didn’t last that very long. I played the downtown bistro, for the exotic dancer. We had played our little tune and then came out this lady singer. And I really didn’t know what she was singing

but her voice was terrible. She just didn’t have any pitch. She was very bad. I don’t sing and I’m probably, really very reluctant of anybody singing because I know I can’t sing; I don’t even try. She got very angry at all of us and she told her boyfriend about it and said “we weren’t playing her music” and I said “she didn’t have any music! She didn’t have any arrangements” I don’t know what she was talking about she just wanted to get rid of us I guess. So that’s how that happened.
